<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, buttonVariants } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
  import {
    Drawer,
    DrawerHeader,
    DrawerPanel,
    DrawerPopup,
    DrawerTitle,
    DrawerTrigger
  } from '$lib/components/ui/drawer';

  let open = $state(false);
</script>

<Drawer position="left" bind:open>
  <DrawerTrigger class={buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline' })}>Open menu</DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerPopup showCloseButton variant="straight">
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Menu</DrawerTitle>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerPanel>
      <nav class="-mx-[calc(--spacing(3)-1px)] flex flex-col gap-0.5">
        <Button
          class="justify-start"
          href="#"
          variant="ghost"
          onclick={() => {
            open = false;
          }}
        >
          Home
        </Button>
        <Button
          class="justify-start"
          href="#"
          variant="ghost"
          onclick={() => {
            open = false;
          }}
        >
          Profile
        </Button>
        <Button
          class="justify-start"
          href="#"
          variant="ghost"
          onclick={() => {
            open = false;
          }}
        >
          Settings
        </Button>
        <Button
          class="justify-start"
          href="#"
          variant="ghost"
          onclick={() => {
            open = false;
          }}
        >
          Sign out
        </Button>
      </nav>
    </DrawerPanel>
  </DrawerPopup>
</Drawer>
